content:
when you look at the sky,

you just wanna fly,

to the heavens above,

like a peace keeping dove

 

when you look at the fire,

u wanna go higher,

like the flames that burn,

as hot as the sun

 

when you look at the sea,

what you remember is me,

coz I’m the endless,

refuge for the soulless!
